name: NVIDIA RTX Spark
desc: A Windows PC for local AI agents, image models and fine-tuning jobs.
desc_zh: 一台为本地跑 AI agent、图像视频模型和微调任务而做的 Windows 电脑。
solves: A laptop sleeps, throttles or travels, so a scheduled agent stops with it; a dedicated box with 128GB of unified memory keeps the work running.
solves_zh: 笔记本会休眠、降频或者被带走，定时 agent 也跟着停；一台带 128GB 统一内存的专用机器能让它一直跑下去。
best_for: You want an agent doing scheduled local work overnight and your only machine today is the laptop you close at six.
best_for_zh: 想让 agent 在夜里跑本地的定时任务，而你现在唯一的机器是六点就合上的笔记本。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/ and https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news）。 Rule-(b) candidate: not in the ledger, and the retail launch falls inside the window. The 2026-10-15 post says the launch 'starts tomorrow', so 2026-10-16 is inferred from that first-party sentence; the compact-desktop form factor shipped 2026-11-18 per the second quote. Publishers announced RTX Spark game support at COMPUTEX in May 2026, so the product name existed earlier than the retail date. The NVIDIA Newsroom second-source URL is the news index, not a story about this product. 首次公开日期来源：https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/local-ai-rtx-spark-launch-event-invite/
